ourKits.combo: Mortal Coil to pull enemies together and heal from them, Stupor from the air to Mesmerize, Soulfire waves for damage, then Abyssal Rift to teleport in and fire the singularity.
ourKits.winCondition: Collect Essence to grow every ability, then zone fights with Mortal Coil and Abyssal Rift and execute low targets.
ourKits.passive: Echoes of the Damned: nearby deaths can drop Essence (heroes always do) that she collects to empower her abilities, and she can hover after a mid-air jump.
ourKits.playWith: A frontline that keeps enemies inside Mortal Coil and the singularity.
ourKits.playAgainst: Watch for the 1.5s Abyssal Rift channel and leave the target area, and dodge the Stupor orb after she rises. Anti-heal cuts Mortal Coil healing; trade early before she stacks Essence.

ourKits.combo: Forward Crunch dashes in to stun, Left Crunch and Right Crunch build Turbo, then the Turbo Crunch version (long push dash, true-damage double swipe, or knockup uppercut) lands, with Re-Crunch repeating the last ability
ourKits.winCondition: chain abilities into Turbo Crunch empowered hits and heal through Re-Crunch's passive
ourKits.passive: each ability empowers his next basic attack and cuts his cooldowns; two ability casts activate Turbo Crunch, enhancing his next basic ability
ourKits.playWith: engage and peel-stripping teammates so he can reach the backline
ourKits.playAgainst: fight after Forward Crunch is used, since it is his long-cooldown gap closer; respect his second ability cast because the next one is Turbo-enhanced; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch healing and armor helps against his physical damage

ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link a carry, Psychic Flare around both of you to blind enemies facing it, Energy Lance to stack slows into a root, and Hyperflux to give both of you attack speed, ability haste and speed.
ourKits.winCondition: Power up a linked carry with the Link and Hyperflux and keep them healthy with Essence Catalyst healing.
ourKits.passive: Essence Catalyst: abilities heal her and her linked ally over time, and her Phase Blink has a shorter cooldown and boosts her damage.
ourKits.playWith: The strongest carry to Link, ideally one who wants attack speed and ability haste.
ourKits.playAgainst: Turn away from Psychic Flare, since it only blinds enemies facing it, and break Energy Lance's beam before it reaches the root. Anti-heal cuts the shared healing; focus the linked carry or force the Link out of range.

ourKits.combo: Root a target with Static Trap, shred armor with Buckshot, stack attack speed with Hot Pursuit and finish with the long-range Charged shot or Long Arm of the Law.
ourKits.winCondition: Control space with traps and out-range enemies with Charged basic attacks, then snipe low targets anywhere with Long Arm of the Law.
ourKits.passive: Shots Fired: after 5 landed basic attacks his next one gains extra range and bonus damage.
ourKits.playWith: A frontline or peeling support, since his only escape tools are Buckshot's push back and Hot Pursuit's speed.
ourKits.playAgainst: Avoid fighting over Static Traps and engage after Buckshot is used, since it is his push-back peel. Stay out of the ult line at low health; armor does not help against Long Arm of the Law.

ourKits.combo: Riplash to pull a hero in, Shock Therapy to break their shield and silence, Electrocute aura for damage and a shield, then Skewer to suppress everyone in front of him.
ourKits.winCondition: Land Riplash and chain silence and suppress so the target cannot fight back while their cooldowns stay frozen.
ourKits.passive: Suspended Sentence: while his abilities immobilize or silence a hero, their cooldowns stop ticking.
ourKits.playWith: Burst that deletes his pulled or suppressed target.
ourKits.playAgainst: Stay behind minions or spaced so Riplash cannot reach you, and fight while it is on cooldown. Tenacity shortens the chain, which also shortens the cooldown freeze.

enemyKits.combo: Ambush leap and slow, Unleash for maximum attack speed cleaving basics, Cull to lock the target, Invigorate to cleanse and heal.
enemyKits.winCondition: Stick to one target, build Rage for regen and faster cooldowns, and out-sustain them in long fights.
enemyKits.passive: Ancestral Fury builds Rage on hits, giving health regen and faster cooldowns, plus movement speed at high Rage.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Buy anti-heal to cut Invigorate and Rage regen. Save your CC until after Invigorate is used since it cleanses, and break off for a few seconds so his Rage decays.

enemyKits.combo: Mark a hero, land Hive to slow and stack Pestilence, run through them with Swarm, then cast Curse on the Marked target to cash the Mark in.
enemyKits.winCondition: Keep Pestilence stacked on a squishy with Hive and Swarm, then finish them with Curse while Mark and Swarm heal her through the trade.
enemyKits.passive: Pestilence: her damaging abilities stack a max-health magical damage over time, and Fetid Dagger hits refresh it.
enemyKits.playWith: Lane partners or junglers with setup that hold her Marked target in place for Curse.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Dodge Hive, since its slow sets up everything else, and trade when Swarm is down because it is her damage reduction, speed and main heal. Anti-heal cuts the healing from Mark and Swarm.

enemyKits.combo: Plasma Grenade slow → Air Assault to hover with extra range → Hypercharge burst → Atomiser to finish a low target
enemyKits.winCondition: hover with Air Assault for extra basic range and shred with Hypercharge, refreshing it on takedowns
enemyKits.passive: extra jump height; kills make the target explode, much larger from enemy heroes
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline that holds enemies in place while she hovers and fires
enemyKits.playAgainst: Air Assault is her only reposition, so engage after it ends and she is back on the ground; dodge Plasma Grenade's slow and sidestep the Atomiser channel, which stops on the first hero hit

enemyKits.combo: Abduct to pull a target in, Beguile to Mesmerize the group, Contagion to heal allies and shred enemy armor, and Eclipse to blind the enemy team's vision and spread Contagion map-wide.
enemyKits.winCondition: Pull a target into his team with Abduct, lock the fight with Beguile and keep allies healthy with Contagion.
enemyKits.passive: Extract: his next basic attack cleaves for bonus damage and restores health.
enemyKits.playWith: Burst damage that punishes his pulled or Mesmerized target and benefits from the armor shred.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Abduct and Beguile are both visible channels that slow Mourn, so sidestep the vines and walk out of the growing Beguile radius before it erupts. Anti-heal blunts Contagion and Extract.

enemyKits.combo: Phantom Rush to fly through and fear enemies, Subjugate to chain them in place, Siphon to steal max health, then Colossal Blow to knock them back.
enemyKits.winCondition: Farm Souls with ability last hits to reach his tiers, then lock fights with fear and Subjugate while Siphon makes him tankier.
enemyKits.passive: Reaper of Souls: ability kills give Souls for bonus health, with tiers adding omnivamp, a magical armor shred aura, stronger Siphon and damage reflect.
enemyKits.playWith: A team that turns his fear and Subjugate lockdown into kills.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Do not walk out of Subjugate while chained, since leaving stuns you; wait it out. Contest his last hits early to slow his Souls, and position so Colossal Blow cannot knock you into his team.

lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,923 hero damage a minute, more than 98% of Renna mid players this patch (30% of the team's). The damage came from Entropy, Wraith Leggings, Overseer.
Abyssal Rift at top rank: 95s base, about 76s by the end (20% shorter) from 25 ability haste: Entropy 15, Tainted Scepter 10.
23 takedowns (12 kills, 11 assists) fed: Tainted Scepter (Malice).
Overseer (Exalted): Enhance your Ultimate Ability: Deals 15% more damage. Heals you for 25% of the damage dealt to Heroes.
Their build heals off damage: anti-heal (the Tainted items) cuts it.
Renna dealt 76,923 hero damage, 30% of their team's, with +525 magical power from items.

Penetration: Wraith Leggings 11, Overseer 8, Caustica ignores 35%; against Khaimera (level 17 estimated: about 60 magical armor, 20 after penetration) and Mourn (level 17 estimated: about 60 magical armor, 20 after penetration) that is about 33% and 33% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Entropy (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 3 (+3.5%) additional Damage. Each Ability can only trigger this effect once every 0.2s, per Target.
Wraith Leggings (item): Against Heroes below 40% Health: Abilities deal 12% bonus Magical Damage.
Overseer (item): Ultimate: Deals 15% more damage. Heals you for 25% of the damage dealt to Heroes.
Tainted Scepter (item): On Dealing Magical Damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 4s.
Tainted Scepter (item): Once every second: Gain a stack of Malice. Stacks up to 15 times. Takedowns grant 15 stacks instantly. Hitting a Hero with Ability Damage will deal 1.5 (+1%) Damage per stack.
Caustica (item): On dealing Ability Damage to a Hero: While they are above 50% Health. For every point of Bonus Magical Armor they possess. Deal 0.2% more Damage.
Sustain: 7% magical lifesteal; Overseer: Ultimate: Deals 15% more damage. Heals you for 25% of the damage dealt to Heroes.; 9,113 healing recorded.
Toughness: +200 health; took 44,927 damage, mitigated 28,912, died 4 times.

Lesson: Renna's penetration cut through: Khaimera took about 33% more magical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 17 (estimated) their armor was about 60, about 20 after 19 flat + 35% penetration).

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 3 effects on one trigger: Entropy, Wraith Leggings, Caustica. Renna has 4 damaging abilities (Stupor hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 25 ability haste brought them back 20% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
Stack (Kept alive in fights): 2 effects on one trigger: Overseer, Caustica. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.
Countered? 0 of the 5 players Renna killed built magical armor. Anti-heal on Khaimera, Morigesh, Skylar, Mourn, Sevarog. We killed Renna 4 times.
Copy it? Too few Renna midlane games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.

bullets: Siphon, Subjugate and Phantom Rush deal magical damage, stacking World Breaker up to 6 times, at most once a second, while Fire Blossom burned nearby enemies.
Forticus shielded Sevarog on taking hero damage, on a cooldown; Fist Of Razuul stacked while trading damage; enemies basic attacking Sevarog took Tainted Guard's bleed and less healing.
Nihil's Doom grew power and armor as Sevarog hit heroes; From the Abyss healed in hero combat; Adaptive Plating stacked matching armor from hits taken, to a cap.
Sky Splitter dealt current-health damage and Tainted Rounds cut the target's healing on every basic attack; during Hypercharge, those on-hit effects apply at only 10% effectiveness.
Weald fired true-damage missiles when Skylar damaged a hero below a health threshold, once per hero per cooldown, with extra missiles from bonus attack speed.
Taproot healed Skylar on basic attacks except tower hits, Terminus turned lifesteal overhealing into a shield, and Forage added gold and experience per minion or monster kill.
Renna's ability hits added Entropy's extra damage; Caustica added more against bonus magical armor while a hero stayed above 50% health, Wraith Leggings once below 40%.
Aion stacked mana regeneration on each cast; Arcane Resonance sped basic ability cooldowns with mana regeneration, up to a cap, so Stupor and Soulfire returned sooner.
Overseer boosted Abyssal Rift's damage and healed Renna from Rift hits on heroes; Bottomless Vial refills a potion charge and adds permanent magical power per River Buff kill.
Abilities and basic attacks each add Vyzar Carapace Scorn on heroes, so Crunch's ability-then-amplified-attack pattern reached 3 stacks quickly for Shell Smash's damage and shield, on cooldown.
Re-Crunch's passive healed Crunch on every third basic attack or ability hit on heroes or monsters, and Forticus shielded Crunch on taking hero damage, on a cooldown.
Nihil's Doom grew power and armor as Crunch hit heroes; Growing Threat added permanent damage and omnivamp from minute 16; Adaptive Plating stacked armor from hits taken, capped.
Hot Pursuit's attack speed meant more landed basic attacks, each building Lightning Hawk Momentum and Sky Splitter damage, and every 5 landed attacks charged Shots Fired.
Dryad's Boon cut basic ability cooldowns on basic attack hits, so Buckshot, Static Trap and Hot Pursuit returned sooner; Taproot healed Murdock on basic attacks, not tower hits.
Weald fired true-damage missiles when Murdock damaged a hero below a health threshold, once per hero per cooldown; bonus attack speed from Hot Pursuit added missiles.
Riktor's ability hits on heroes stacked Magnify's magical armor shred and World Breaker's damage; casts empowered the next basic attack within 4s via Elafrost, on a short cooldown.
Krix added max health and size; Festering Wounds cut heroes' healing through Skewer's suppress and Electrocute's damage over time; Feeding Frenzy added attack speed per nearby enemy hero.
Forticus shielded Riktor on taking hero damage, on a cooldown; Electrocute added a shield, and taking damage during the aura fired extra pulses on a short cooldown.
